svg.title: Theorem A(a): Archimedean Size and Level-Cancellation Ledger
svg.desc: Publication-grade editorial mathematical diagram tracing the four-band archimedean size and level-cancellation ledger for Theorem A(a) across src/New/UpperBound/Size/ShortColumns.lean and ArchimedeanSize.lean. Band 1 (B-Short Ramified Source Forms, ShortColumns.lean) starts on the left with free-level spanning forms (span_isShort_eq_top) of shortness B_0 = exp(errorUnit) / 4^f having integral Weyl gauge at every prime p and weylNormSq(sigma phi) <= B_0 for all sigma in Aut(C); applying ramifyingOp = prod_{w | pi_N} (1 - z_w) kills unramified scalars at all f places w | pi_N at a dimension cost of at most f/(N-1) <= b^(-8) (le_finrank_ramifiedSourceForms) while multiplying shortness by 4^f, yielding span_isShort_ramifiedSourceForms_eq_top with B = exp(errorUnit) where errorUnit = f a (log b)^3. Band 2 (m Definite Theta Kernels and Trivial-Twist Expansion, ArchimedeanSize.lean) traces the m lifts X_0 -> X_1 -> ... -> X_m followed by restrictToY to Y_m (saving -|Phi_a| a log N), expanding a glued IsChainDatum 1 Psi at the trivial twist TameChar.one (vartheta.Q = empty) into an unglued IsWeakChainDatum 1 Psi' with restrictedChain 1 Psi' phi = compositeLift 1 Psi phi; each kernel j satisfies sqrt_weylNormSq_jetMap_le with factor exp(x^50 + rowSizeSum(j)/2), summing across j < m via sum_rowSizeSum_le to chainSize + errorUnit/2 where chainSize = m(|Phi_a| s_infty(a) + k sum_tau s_infty(kappa(tau))). Band 3 (Stirling + Chowla-Selberg + Level-N Cancellation Ledger) displays three side-by-side cancellations: C1 (jetSize_sub_mainPrimeSum_le) uses log Omega = -1 - c_1 + log(2 pi / rd_E) to cancel -a and c_1 identically between s_infty(a) and s_main; C2 (mul_jetSize_sub_mainPrimeSum_sub_le) cancels m(s_infty(a) - s_main) against -|Phi_a| a log N from restrictToY down to at most 32 f a log b; C3 (two_mul_sum_gain_mul_log and mainAmount_sub_add_two_mul_sum_gain) cancels s_fin identically and rewrites chainSize - |Phi_a| a log N <= h_main - m rem + 2 sum gain_p log p + errorUnit. Band 4 (Composite Lift Bound, Good Projection, and Stage 01 Handoff) chains weylNormSq_compositeLift_le at TameChar.one (bound exp(B + h_main - m rem + 2 sum gain_p log p + errorUnit)), the good projection |G| e_0 s (goodProjTranslate_mem_integralForms preserving integrality for all tame twists vartheta, while normSqAt_goodProjTranslate_le enlarges normSqAt by at most exp(x^99) at TameChar.one), and Stage 01's invGainFactor c_B = prod ell^(-g_ell) whose square c_B^2 cancels +2 sum gain_p log p to leave exp(h_main - m rem + f a log^4 b) for Theorem A(a), accompanied by an explicit dashed badge emphasizing the TwistedLattice split (untwisted sizes at TameChar.one, twisted p-adic valuations across vartheta).

g.text: Theorem A(a): Archimedean Size & Level-Cancellation Ledger
① BAND 1 — B-SHORT RAMIFIED SOURCE FORMS
• Integral Weyl gauge at every prime p
kills unramified scalars at all f places w | πN
∑i<N−1 zwi φ = 0 at every w | πN
B-short ramified input φ on X0
② BAND 2 — m DEFINITE THETA KERNELS & TRIVIAL-TWIST EXPANSION
Unglues mod-N sum at TameChar.one (≤ exp(x60) ℓ¹ budget)
compositeLift 1 Ψ φ = restrictedChain 1 Ψ′ φ (sizes & p≠N)
Stage 02 vacuum-jet bound applied to Schur jet of order a + 1
Three exact cancellations rewrite chainSize − #Φa · a log N
③ BAND 3 — STIRLING + CHOWLA–SELBERG + LEVEL-N CANCELLATION LEDGER
+ s∞(a) = log a! + a log(M / Ω)
s∞(a) − smain ≤ a(log κ̄ + G) + 1 + ½ log a
N window: log N ≥ m(log κ̄+G) − O(log b)
Residual ≤ 32 f a log b (≪ errorUnit)
Net Ledger (chainSize_sub_le + slacks): chainSize − #Φa a log N ≤ hmain − m·rem + 2 ∑ gainp log p + errorUnit
Assemble input B + m kernels + restriction + good projection
④ BAND 4 — COMPOSITE LIFT BOUND, GOOD PROJECTION & STAGE 01 HANDOFF
Multiply by cB2 with cB = ∏ ℓ−gℓ
exp(hmain − m·rem + f a log⁴ b)
Matches Stage 01 TwistedLattice split: archimedean sizes & covolumes are untwisted (ϑ = 1, Q = ∅),
while p-adic valuations & good-projection integrality hold across prime-avoiding twists ϑ.
